cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: CodeFellow combines local compiler and test diagnostics with hint-first programming education in English and natural Kiswahili/English code-switching. It preserves standard coding terms while specializing in correct minimal Python and JavaScript repairs, focused tests, and beginner-friendly offline explanations.

test_prompts.prompt:
Implement the Python function derivative(xs). Preserve this exact function name and argument contract. The list xs stores polynomial coefficients in ascending power order: xs[0] + xs[1]*x + xs[2]*x**2 + .... Return the derivative coefficients in the same format. Examples: derivative([3, 1, 2, 4, 5]) returns [1, 4, 12, 20], derivative([1, 2, 3]) returns [2, 6], and derivative([7]) returns []. Do not mutate xs.

Respond in English. Return exactly one fenced python code block containing the complete implementation. After the block, add a concise English explanation in no more than two sentences. Do not include tests.

Implement Python function is_palindrome(text). Hifadhi exact function name na argument contract. Requirement: return True if string inasomeka sawa forward na backward; otherwise return False. Examples: is_palindrome('') returns True, is_palindrome('aba') returns True, and is_palindrome('zbcd') returns False.

Jibu kwa closed python code fence moja tu containing the complete implementation. Hakuna docstring, comments, tests, headings, au extra prose.
